subtitles.en: All righty we're here to talk about combat sports. I want to hear the energy. I want to see it You know, I want to feel it because that's what all it's all about, right? Always so Jake and Kizu guys
subtitles.zh: 好了，我们来聊聊格斗运动。我想感受那股能量，想亲眼看到，想亲身体会，因为这才是关键，对吧？一直都是这样。杰克和基祖，两位好。

subtitles.en: We're just here recently feels like it was just a couple of weeks ago to talk about the recent merger between MVP and PFL Jake what's been the reception in the combat sports community?
subtitles.zh: 我们最近刚来过，感觉就像几周前，聊了MVP和PFL的合并。杰克，格斗圈的反响怎么样？

subtitles.en: It's been good, you know And I think people realize the power and the company that we've created and the importance of
subtitles.zh: 反响很好。我觉得人们意识到了我们创造的公司力量，以及重要性。

subtitles.en: Having a number two entity on the MMA side where other fighters can go to and get just as big of paydays if not more and
subtitles.zh: 在MMA领域有第二大平台，让其他拳手也能去，拿到同样甚至更高的报酬。

subtitles.en: the same amount of attention if not more and so really It's the thesis of our whole organization which is fighter first and
subtitles.zh: 获得同样甚至更多的关注。这就是我们整个组织的理念：拳手优先。

subtitles.en: the reception of all the fighters wanting to do something with us the excitement behind it and And
subtitles.zh: 所有拳手都想和我们合作，那种兴奋感，以及……

subtitles.en: There's never been a boxing and MMA entity that's all under the same roof vertically integrated So you feel like people got that vision get the vision of having them under one roof together. I
subtitles.zh: 从来没有一个拳击和MMA实体能垂直整合在同一屋檐下。所以你觉得人们理解了那个愿景，把两者放在一起。

subtitles.en: Think they'll understand it more as time goes on And I think it's mainly because of like the brandy and element of it and what we're gonna be calling each sides of it, but
subtitles.zh: 随着时间推移，他们会更理解。我认为这主要是因为品牌元素，以及我们怎么称呼双方，但……

subtitles.en: Yeah, there's a ton of excitement around it because for so long the fans have wanted to see certain fights that don't get made because
subtitles.zh: 是的，有很多兴奋感，因为长期以来粉丝们想看的某些比赛没能举办，因为……

terms.context: business structure of a combined boxing and MMA entity
terms.sense: combining multiple stages of production and distribution under one ownership
prioritizing fighters' interests in promotion decisions

clip_research.source_claim: There has never been a boxing and MMA entity that's all under the same roof vertically integrated.
clip_research.public_baseline: Public reporting confirms the MVP-PFL merger creates a combined boxing and MMA company under the MVP banner, described as a landmark merger and a potential credible alternative to the UFC.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The speaker frames the combined boxing-and-MMA structure as unprecedented, while public coverage presents it as a notable but not necessarily unique consolidation in combat sports; the claim of 'never been' is a strong assertion not independently verified by the returned snippets.

evidence.fact: Jake Paul says the merger creates a number two entity on the MMA side where fighters can get just as big paydays and attention, and describes the thesis as 'fighter first'.
PFL official announcement confirms MVP and PFL merged under the MVP banner to create a new global combat sports platform.
ESPN describes the MVP-PFL combination as a 'landmark merger' in combat sports.

forbidden_claims: Do not claim this is the first vertically integrated boxing and MMA entity without independent verification.
Do not claim the merger has already changed fighter pay or attention levels; the transcript only states the intention.
Do not attribute the 'fighter first' thesis to PFL or any party other than Jake Paul/MVP.

notes: Chinese Wikipedia and Baidu Baike were used for PFL and MMA terminology; Bloomberg and Yahoo Sports were used for MVP and Jake Paul.
No reliable Chinese name was found for Nakisa Bidarian or Bloomberg Power Players; title labels remain in English.
The merger date in public snippets varies (July 2026 per CageSidePress, September 2026 per Bloomberg video); the exact announcement date is not resolved here.
